answer: The willow counter is kept in velvet and haven makes public each reset. An copycat hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 5 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
